summary: Base image of decision-embed from python:3.11-slim to python:3.14-slim (Dependabot proposed 3.15-slim). onnxruntime 1.32.0 publishes no Python 3.15 wheel yet, so the image build on 3.15-slim fails ('No matching distribution found for onnxruntime', reproduced with podman); 3.14-slim is the newest base for which numpy, onnxruntime and tokenizers all have wheels. The digest sha256:9aaa474097d094040649f2162a627c0049b408f52138d980916788d80f04802f equals the current index digest of python:3.14-slim on Docker Hub (pushed 2026-11-08), so the reference stays immutable (ADR-0055). Built with podman: Python 3.14.10, numpy 2.5.5, onnxruntime 1.32.0, tokenizers 0.23.3; server.py's embedder module imports. The pip install line, the loopback-only port binding in compose.yaml, the /models volume and the entrypoint are unchanged. No new trust boundary, port, credential or network destination at runtime.

findings.evidence: A third-party base image is updated; the decision service runs the router's routing classifier.
findings.resolution: Pre-existing and unchanged in scope: the base image stays pinned by digest (verified against the registry); the Python packages are installed unpinned as before (unchanged by this PR).

tests.command: Docker Hub registry HEAD /v2/library/python/manifests/3.14-slim (index media types)
tests.evidence: Docker-Content-Digest sha256:9aaa474097d094040649f2162a627c0049b408f52138d980916788d80f04802f, identical to the pinned digest.

tests.command: podman build decision-embed on python:3.15-slim (Dependabot's proposal)
tests.evidence: Fails as expected: ERROR: No matching distribution found for onnxruntime - the reason 3.15 is not taken.

tests.command: podman build decision-embed on python:3.14-slim, then python -c 'import numpy, onnxruntime, tokenizers, embedder'

limitations: The service was not started with the real model; the router CT's image is only replaced when the operator rebuilds and restarts the embed service.
python:3.14-slim was pushed on 2026-11-08; the operator's 7-day minimum image age is reached on 2026-11-15.
